meta.description.text: A puzzle game: a line of kunobitos leaves the Nest and walks on without thinking. Give them skills to lead them to the Dojo across 28 levels, with your stars and belts saved on this device.

text: Add a level 29 to the Master group: a glass wall and a pond, with 2 Steps and 3 Smokes.
In the level “The pond”, give 5 Steps instead of 3 and require all 10 of 10 kunobitos to make it.

words.titulo.gancho.text: Little ninjas who walk without looking. You decide how they reach the Dojo.

words.ayuda.paso1.text: The kunobitos leave the Nest and walk on their own, without looking.

words.ayuda.paso2.text: Pick a skill and tap a kunobito to give it.

words.ayuda.paso3.text: Get as many to the Dojo as the level asks before time runs out.

words.ayuda.una.text: As many arrive as the level asks

words.ayuda.controles.text: **Controls:** drag to move the view; scroll, pinch or + and − to zoom. Keys: **1–8** skill, **P** pause, **F** ×2, **+** and **−** release rate, **M** sound.

words.turnos.explica.text: You both play the same level on this device, one after the other. Whoever gets more kunobitos to the Dojo wins.

words.lista.pie.text: Each level opens when you clear the one before. Your progress is saved on this device.

words.habilidades.trepa.queHace.text: Climbs up walls. Adds to whatever else it does; you can give it mid-air.

words.habilidades.hoja.queHace.text: Glides down and lands safely from any height. You can give it mid-air.

words.habilidades.planton.queHace.text: Stands still with arms wide open: the others bounce off and turn back.

words.habilidades.chispa.queHace.text: Counts to 5 and bursts, opening a hole in the earth (not in glass). That kunobito is lost.

words.habilidades.peldano.queHace.text: Lays 12 planks going diagonally up. Give it right before what needs crossing.

words.habilidades.tunel.queHace.text: Digs straight ahead until it comes out of the earth. Give it a little early and it walks up first.

words.habilidades.pico.queHace.text: Digs diagonally down: a ramp to walk down safely.

words.habilidades.pozo.queHace.text: Digs straight down until it breaks through the floor.

words.habilidades.gancho.queHace.text: Throws a rope to a ledge ahead and above, climbs up and goes over. If there's nothing to hook onto, it isn't used up.

words.habilidades.salto.queHace.text: Leaps in an arc over spikes, short ponds and gaps, and lands on its feet.

words.habilidades.humo.queHace.text: Vanishes in a cloud and comes out on the other side of a thin wall, glass too. Give it close to the wall.

words.habilidades.kunai.queHace.text: Drives four kunai into the wall ahead: it and everyone behind climb up them.

words.habilidades.sigilo.queHace.text: Crouches for about 10 seconds: the watch lanterns can't see it, or the one right behind it.

words.habilidades.cometa.queHace.text: Flies straight across on the wind; with no wind it glides. Give it before the edge or mid-air.

words.partida.objetivoGeneral.text: The kunobitos leave the Nest and walk on their own. Pick a skill below and tap a kunobito to give it. Get at least as many to the Dojo as the level asks before time runs out.

words.partida.controles.text: **Controls:** tap a kunobito to give it the skill · drag to move the view · scroll, pinch or + / − to zoom · minimap to jump. **Keys:** 1–{{n}} skill, P pause, F ×2, + / − rate, M sound, ? help.

words.partida.peligros.text: A fall from very high stuns them, and water or leaving the map loses them. Glass can't be dug or broken.

words.partida.estrellasRegla.text: **Stars:** ★ if as many reach the Dojo as the level asks, ★★ if two are lost at most, and ★★★ if everyone arrives.

words.partida.lienzo.text: Level: tap a kunobito to give it the chosen skill

words.partida.objetivo.text: Get at least **{{minimo}}** of **{{total}}** kunobitos to the Dojo in **{{tiempo}}**.

words.partida.minimapa.text: Minimap: tap to move the view

data.niveles.grupos[raices].texto.text: New skills and the first combo.

data.niveles.grupos[cumbres].texto.text: Several skills in the same level.

data.niveles.grupos[bambu].texto.text: Jump and Hook among the canes.

data.niveles.grupos[bambu].aviso.text: Spikes take out whoever steps on them. Only Tunnel gets through bamboo.

data.niveles.grupos[tejados].texto.text: Sneak and Smoke in the village at night.

data.niveles.grupos[tejados].aviso.text: The watch lantern sends anyone it sees without Sneak back to the Nest. Roof tiles can't be walked up, and paper falls all at once at the first hit.

data.niveles.grupos[montana].texto.text: Kite and Kunai on the snowy peak.

data.niveles.grupos[montana].aviso.text: The wind carries whoever flies with the Kite; the waterfall knocks down anyone flying or climbing. Snow digs fast; ice can't be dug and it's slippery.

data.niveles.grupos[maestro].aviso.text: While someone stands on a plate, its gate stays open.

data.niveles.niveles[hacia-abajo].pista.text: The Dojo is under the floor. Give one kunobito Shaft and the others will drop down the hole.

data.niveles.niveles[el-muro].pista.text: A wall of earth blocks the way. Tunnel digs straight ahead, even if you give it a little before the wall.

data.niveles.niveles[la-charca].pista.text: Anyone who falls in the water is lost. Step builds a bridge: give it right before the edge.

data.niveles.niveles[alto].pista.text: They head for the cliff and the Dojo is behind them. A Stand makes them turn around.

data.niveles.niveles[paracaidas].pista.text: The drop is too high. With the Leaf each kunobito glides down; give it before the edge.

data.niveles.niveles[escalada].pista.text: Glass can't be dug or broken. With Climb they go up the wall and down the other side.

data.niveles.niveles[bajo-la-roca].pista.text: Glass blocks the way at foot height. Pick digs diagonally and goes under it; start far from the wall.

data.niveles.niveles[abre-paso].pista.text: No Tunnel: a Stand right against the wall and, to that same kunobito, a Spark. Its burst opens the way.

data.niveles.niveles[doble-escalon].pist.text: The Dojo is up high, 24 pixels up. A Step climbs 12: when it ends, give the same kunobito another.

data.niveles.niveles[bajo-el-cristal].pi.text: Above, a glass wall. Below, a wall of earth. Go down first, then through.

data.niveles.niveles[puente-y-bajada].pi.text: First, a bridge over the water. Then the ground ends at a cliff: Pick goes down bit by bit, safely.

data.niveles.niveles[el-largo-camino].pi.text: A wall, a pond, a plateau and a glass step. Lay the Steps right before what needs crossing.

data.niveles.niveles[pinchos].pista.text: The bamboo stakes take out whoever steps on them. Jump clears them: give it a little before.

data.niveles.niveles[la-cana-alta].pista.text: The Dojo is up high, above the canes. Hook throws a rope to a ledge ahead and above, and climbs up.

data.niveles.niveles[pasarela-rota].pist.text: First the spikes, then the ledge: Jump and Hook, one after the other.

data.niveles.niveles[el-bosque-cerrado]..text: Only Tunnel gets through bamboo. Then spikes and a high step: a Jump for each one and a Step for everyone.

data.niveles.niveles[la-linterna].pista.text: There isn't Sneak for everyone. But the lantern can't see the one right behind a sneaking kunobito either: speed up the release (+) and give it to every other one.

data.niveles.niveles[puerta-de-cristal]..text: Glass can't be dug, but Smoke goes through it if it's thin. Paper, on the other hand, falls all at once at the first hit.

data.niveles.niveles[muro-de-papel].pist.text: Behind the paper a lantern keeps watch, and at the end there's a roof you can't walk up. Tunnel, Sneak in pairs and a Jump to get up.

data.niveles.niveles[ronda-de-noche].pis.text: Two lanterns in a row and, at the end, a glass wall. Sneak in pairs lasts through both if you give it early.

data.niveles.niveles[el-barranco].pista.text: The wind blows over the ravine. With the Kite, whoever jumps into the void flies to the other side.

data.niveles.niveles[pared-helada].pista.text: Ice can't be dug and is hard to climb. A single Kunai leaves a ladder for everyone.

data.niveles.niveles[la-cascada].pista.text: The waterfall knocks down anyone flying: the Kite won't work. Underneath, the snow digs fast.

data.niveles.niveles[la-cumbre].pista.text: A high drop, a windy ravine and an ice wall. Leaf to go down, Kite to cross and Kunai to climb.

data.niveles.niveles[la-placa].pista.text: While someone stands on the plate in the pit, the gate stays open. Let one drop in and the rest jump; then, a bridge. At the end, the Finish button wraps it up.

data.niveles.niveles[prueba-del-humo].pi.text: A lantern, a glass wall and a ledge: Sneak in pairs, Smoke and Hook.

data.niveles.niveles[prueba-del-viento]..text: Spikes on the plateau, a windy ravine and an ice wall: Jump, Kite and Kunai.

data.niveles.niveles[el-camino-del-ninja.text: Everything you've learned: paper, spikes, the lantern, glass, wind and ice. Make pairs early.
